basic_info.description: This is a charming junior one-bedroom at the iconic Opera Plaza.The unit is filled with natural light, has pleasing city views, and showcases wood floors.  The kitchen has stainless appliances, an electric range, and there are multiple closets with plenty of storage throughout the unit.  Opera Plaza offers a full spectrum of amenities including 24-hour security, a pool and spa, fitness center, concierge services, and more.  The location is superb with shops cinema, and public transportation less than one block away.  Don't miss the Pete's Coffee at street level.  Also, this complex is mere blocks from the performing arts center containing the War Memorial Opera House, SF Jazz, Symphony Hall, and more. Leased parking available on site.
